title: Pretty Small
text: Pretty Small. I'm not really sure these are going to work for baking. They are way too small. Maybe holds 1/4 of a cup allowing for something to rise and not run over.  They are cute, but not functional.

product_metadata.title: Reusable Silicone Muffin Pans | 24 Pack Fluted Tube Cupcake Liners | Non Stick Cake Baking Mold | Food Grade Silicone Donuts Baking Cups | Handmade Soap Mold
features: Made of food grade silicone, 24 pcs reusable cupcake baking cups. Work as muffin liners, snack cups, food divider and soap mold.
Good alternatives to paper cake cups, muffin pans or tins. Easily to pop out and clean up. More flexible than traditional metal or aluminum bakeware.
Long-lasting baking performance. Oven and dishwasher safe. Temperature safe from -40 to +446℉/ (-40 to +230℃)
6 shapes: flower, star, pumpkin, love heart, round and spiral. 4 colors: orchid, sky, light pink, mint.
Ideal for baking and making food, like tarts, cupcakes, muffins, chocolates, bagels, pastries, pudding, ice cube.
